must_have_properties: MDC is driven by the STA at up to 2.5 MHz; MDIO is open-drain with an external pull-up.
Every transaction is a 32-bit preamble (32 ones) followed by a 32-bit management frame.
Clause 22 frame = ST(2) + OP(2) + PHYAD(5) + REGAD(5) + TA(2) + DATA(16).
TA is 10 on a write and Z0 on a read (STA tri-states bit 1, PHY drives 0 in bit 2).
PHYAD/PRTAD selects one of up to 32 PHYs/ports; non-selected PHYs leave MDIO high-impedance.
Clause 45 uses indirect addressing: an Address frame loads the 16-bit register address used by subsequent frames.
MDIO has no START/STOP conditions and no acknowledge (distinct from I2C).
must_not_have_properties: Two simultaneous masters driving MOSI/SCK without mode-fault arbitration
Two slaves both selected on the same MISO line (output contention)

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Third byte received while SPIF still set and not serviced before start of third transmission.
SS pulled LOW while configured master + MODFEN=1.

fields.min_baud_rate_constraint: Implementation-defined per SoC; spec note: max allowed baud rate per SoC SPI Electrical Specification.
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: After reset SPE=0, SPTEF=1, SPIF=0, MODF=0, MSTR=0, CPOL=1, CPHA=0, all data registers cleared.
fields.min_bus_capacitance_constraint: No minimum stated; maximum is per-mode (Sm/Fm 400 pF; Fm+ 550 pF; Hs 100 pF @ 3.4 MHz / 400 pF @ 1.7 MHz).
must_have_if_device_identification_regis: Device Identification Register is exactly 32 bits.
Bit 0 of Device ID is hard-wired to 1.
fields.min_link_constraint: Every PHY shall be able to bring up its link at least at one of the supported PMD speeds (10 / 100 / 1000 Mb/s) in either half- or full-duplex. AutoNeg-capable PHYs shall always reach AN_LINK_OK within the spec's break_link_timer when at least one PMD is in common with the partner.
fields.frame_boundary_compliance: TX_EN must assert synchronous with the first preamble nibble and remain asserted continuously through all nibbles of the frame; must de-assert before the next TX_CLK rising edge after the final FCS nibble. RX_DV must encompass the frame starting no later than the SFD and de-assert before the next RX_CLK after the final FCS nibble.
fields.address_filter_compliance: Receive MAC must accept (a) its own unicast MAC, (b) the broadcast address FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF, (c) any multicast address it has been programmed to listen for, and (d) all frames in promiscuous mode (when enabled). Hash-based filtering of the multicast superset is implementation-defined.
mdio_distinguishers: Two-wire MDC + MDIO management bus, not a 4-wire SPI link and not a TAP.
Fixed 32-bit frame with a turnaround (TA) field — no I2C start/stop/ACK.
In-frame 5-bit PHYAD selects the PHY — no separate chip-select.
